title: My dad had a mallworld dream last night , his town sign said " Emergency City"
content: I guess we had been having separate mallworld dreams completely unbeknownst to each other , but recently we have been discussing our dreams and have found we dream in exactly the same location, I enjoy lucid dreaming but my dad is more of a passenger / passive dreamer so it's interesting to approach our dreams and experiences in mallworld from that perspective. He seems to live in the " ruined " version of that city where I live in the pristine futuristic version which is interesting. That's all, thanks for reading.
